title: Chengdu Panda Base Guide 2026: Tickets, Price & Route
heading: Chengdu Panda Base Guide: Tickets, Route and Visiting Tips (2026)
description: Chengdu Panda Base adult tickets are CNY 55. Book with passport details via official channels; see options without a Chinese number, gate routes and hours.
quickAnswer: The Chengdu Panda Base lists a CNY 55 adult ticket and real-name reservations up to 14 days ahead while quotas remain. A passport is an accepted ID; bring the original used for booking. Without a Chinese phone number, check the officially authorized Trip.com channel; on-site payment help is conditional on tickets remaining. The base describes an ID-photo verification channel if you lack the original document, but allow extra time and do not rely on it. Choose South or West Gate for your route and check the official hours for your date.

items: The official ticket page says reservations can be made up to 14 days ahead and sales stop when the daily quota is full.
The listed prices and hours were checked on October 19, 2026. Recheck the official ticket and opening-hours pages for your date before paying.
A Chengdu Panda Base ticket does not include the separate Dujiangyan Panda Valley.

contentSections.title: Booking with a foreign passport or without a Chinese phone number
items: The base accepts passports as booking and entry identity documents. Enter the name and passport details as required by the chosen official or authorized reservation channel; confirm the date and morning or afternoon entry session.

The base lists its official WeChat account and mini program, plus authorized platforms including Trip.com. Its 2026 holiday notice specifically directs visitors unable to book online without a Chinese mobile number to Trip.com or the Cash and Cards service window when tickets remain. Check the current arrangement for your visit date; a walk-up ticket is not guaranteed.

Bring the original document used in the reservation. The base also describes a separate verification channel for visitors without the original document who have a photo of their own ID; allow extra time and verify with staff rather than assuming automatic entry.

If online payment fails, the base's current ticket page mentions on-site ticket windows for special circumstances subject to availability. During some peak periods separate notices may require advance online reservations, so confirm the latest rule before heading there.

contentSections.title: Book the right ticket before you travel
items: Start from the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding's official ticket page and read the current date, entry session, real-name and accepted-document rules.

Use the exact passport or other valid document details required by the reservation. Bring the original for the standard entry channel; the official ticket page also describes a photo-of-ID verification channel if the original is unavailable.
Check whether you booked a morning or afternoon slot; an afternoon ticket does not mean you can enter during the morning session.
A ticket for the base, a sightseeing bus ticket, a guide and transport from your hotel are different products. Compare only what each one actually includes.
Save your booking and gate name offline. If the ticket system or passport entry is unclear, use the official visitor contact or authorised booking channel before travel.

items: The base's official transport page distinguishes South and West Gate approaches. Save the gate name in Chinese for the driver or map app.
The park is large; do not assume a sightseeing bus instantly takes you to every enclosure or that queues disappear.
If your route ends at the other gate, calculate how to reach your next stop or hotel from that gate before leaving.

contentSections.title: Chengdu Panda Base route for a half-day visit
items: Enter in your reserved session and photograph the park map or use the official map before choosing an area.
Prioritise a small number of panda viewing areas, then walk between them at a comfortable pace. Check staff signs for temporary closures.
Allow time for queues and for moments when an enclosure is quiet. Do not plan the visit around a promised feeding or animal appearance.
Take a break in the shade or at an official rest area. In warm weather, pandas may spend more time indoors or resting.
Leave enough time for the correct gate, booked transport and a relaxed afternoon in Chengdu. Add one nearby food or tea block rather than another distant attraction.

items: The official base lists a separate sightseeing-bus service with its own stops, hours and CNY 30 fare. Check the current route and whether your desired stop is served.
The bus can reduce walking for a large park or mixed-ability group, but you may still need to queue and walk between habitats.
Check the direction: the South-to-West route is not identical to the West-to-South route.
Do not purchase it automatically if you only plan a compact walking route near your entry gate.
For limited mobility, verify accessibility, gradients and available assistance with the base rather than assuming every viewing area has the same access.

contentSections.title: Panda welfare and respectful viewing
items: Keep noise down, follow barriers and staff instructions, and never feed or touch an animal.
Use permitted photography without flash where site rules require it. Do not block others for a long video or attempt to enter a restricted work area.
Animal visibility changes with individual behaviour, care routines and weather. A quiet enclosure does not mean your ticket is invalid.
If a particular panda is important to you, check current official notices and accept that no visitor itinerary can guarantee a sighting.

faqs: How much is the Chengdu Panda Base ticket?

The official ticket page currently lists adult admission at CNY 55 and an eligible student ticket at CNY 27. The sightseeing bus is a separate CNY 30 service. Check the official page again for your date because prices, eligibility, and sales arrangements can change.
Do I need to book Chengdu Panda Base tickets in advance?
The official ticket page describes real-name online reservations and a reserved entry session. Check availability and the accepted booking channels for your date.
Can a foreign visitor use a passport?

Yes. The base lists passports among accepted admission documents. Enter matching details when booking and bring the original for the standard entry channel. If it is unavailable, the official ticket page describes a separate channel with a photo of your own ID and staff verification; entry is not automatic.
How can I book Panda Base tickets without a Chinese phone number?

The base lists Trip.com as an authorized booking platform and named it for foreign visitors without a Chinese mobile number in a 2026 holiday notice. A Cash and Cards window may help when tickets remain, but walk-up access is not guaranteed. Check your date's latest official notice.
Choose South or West Gate according to your ticket, route and transport. The park's official transport information distinguishes them; save your actual gate name.
Treat it as a separate service unless your purchased product explicitly includes it. Check the current official route, price and operating hours.
No specific animal sighting can be guaranteed. Panda behaviour, animal care, weather and closures can change what is visible.
